verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented Fellow feature that automatically surfaces past meetings with the same attendees, or generates a pre-call brief of open threads. What exists is adjacent: searchable past transcripts the user must look up, MCP or Ask Fellow question-answering the user must prompt, and API endpoints (notes with attendee emails, action-item filters) a developer could use to build such a brief. None of these is the product's own pre-meeting prep capability.

support.subject: As a founder, I walk into each meeting prepped — the tool surfaces past meetings with the same people and a brief of open threads before the call
